policy_metadata.policy_title: Modifiers for Occupational Therapy, Physical Therapy and Speech Language Pathology

sections.heading: Overview
content: This policy outlines Humana’s billing requirements for reporting occupational therapy, physical therapy and speech language pathology services using appropriate modifiers.

sections.heading: Kentucky Medicaid Payment Policy
content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Humana requires providers to report the appropriate modifier, as outlined below, to identify occupational therapy, physical therapy and speech language pathology services: • Report modifier GN for a speech language pathology service • Report modifier GO for an occupational therapy service • Report modifier GP for a physical therapy service Humana also requires providers to report the appropriate modifier, as outlined below, to identify whether the service was rendered for habilitative or rehabilitative purposes: • Report modifier 96 for a habilitative service • Report modifier 97 for a rehabilitative service

sections.heading: Definitions of Italicized Terms
content: • Modifier 96 : Habilitative services • Modifier 97 : Rehabilitative services • Modifier GN : Services delivered under an outpatient speech language pathology plan of care • Modifier GO : Services delivered under an outpatient occupational therapy plan of care • Modifier GP : Services delivered under an outpatient physical therapy plan of care
